title: AI Automation Analyst
description: About OpenLoopOpenLoop was co-founded by CEO, Dr. Jon Lensing, and COO, Christian Williams, with the vision to bring care anywhere. Our telehealth support solutions are thoughtfully designed to streamline and simplify go-to-market care delivery for companies offering meaningful virtual support to patients across an expansive array of specialties, in all 50 states.About The RoleMost revenue teams talk about AI. Fewer have it running in production. At OpenLoop, AI agents are already enriching leads, recategorizing support tickets, parsing contracts, and moving data between CRM and different tools. We're looking for an AI Automation Analyst to build the next wave of it.This is a hands-on build role. You'll spend your week building AI automations and agents for CRM and other tools, wiring workflows, testing what breaks, and fixing it before someone in Sales or Marketing notices.You'll work from a prioritized roadmap owned by the Senior Manager of Revenue Automation & AI, and you'll own the builds assigned to you end to end: scoped, shipped, documented, monitored.You'll partner directly with the people who use what you build—AEs, AMs, CSMs, Implementation, Marketing, and Finance—which means you'll need to understand the process before you automate it. If manual work that a well-designed workflow should be handling genuinely bothers you, and you'd rather ship the thing than write the deck about the thing, this role was written for you.What You'll OwnProduction AI agents. Build and maintain the LLM-backed agents driving the revenue engine - intent filtering, lead grading and re-classification, enrichment, contract parsing, competitive monitoring. You own the prompt design, the tool wiring, the structured output contract, and the failure handling.End-to-end integrations. Architect and deploy durable data flows across HubSpot, Salesforce, Make.com, Jira, NetSuite, and the ad platforms, triggered by deal milestones and lifecycle events — so GTM handoffs are programmatic rather than memory-dependent.Production AI Agents – Develop and refine the LLM-backed agents driving the revenue engine—from intent filtering and MQL grading to contract parsing—owning the prompt design, tool wiring, and rigorous failure handling required for production.Migration readiness for what we've already built. Inventory the automations in your area, document what each one actually writes and where, identify what breaks at Salesforce cutover, and port or retire it.Reliability of your own builds. Alerting, error triage, mean time to restore. A shipped automation nobody is watching is a liability with a countdown on it. You own yours after launch, not just at launch.Process discovery and documentation. Sit with the AEs, AMs, CSMs, and Implementation folks who live inside the process before you automate it — then write it down so any teammate can pick your build up cold, including how to recover it when it breaks.Impact & Data Inputs – Track the before-and-after metrics for every ship—capturing process baselines and hours returned—so the automation pod's impact number is defensible to Finance and executive leadership.Adoption & Feedback Loops – Partner with Revenue Enablement to drive weekly active use of your builds, sitting with the teams to identify friction and iterating until the workflow is a native part of their dayRequirements2–5 years in revenue operations, marketing operations, sales operations, systems, or automation—with real build ownership, not just ticket triageHands-on CRM depth: workflows, properties, custom objects, list logic, lifecycle stages, and a genuine understanding of how data moves and gets corrupted inside a CRM. HubSpot or Salesforce; both are a strong advantage given where we're headed.Working experience with at least one automation platform (Make.com, Zapier, Workato, n8n, or similar)—you've built multi-step scenarios with branching, error handling, and API callsYou've built with LLMs, not just used ChatGPT—prompt design, structured output, tool use, and handling the cases where the model gets it wrongThe instinct to check your own work: you test edge cases, you don't trust a run that "looked fine," and you say so when you're unsureComfort working across messy, multi-system data environments (CRM + financial systems + support + product data)Clear written communication—you can explain a build to someone who will never open Make.comFluency in English (C1), excellent written and verbal communication skills.Familiarity with Clay, Claude Code, Salesforce, Codex, Zoho Desk, NetSuite, Stripe, or Coefficient a plusHealthcare or other regulated-data experience, including PHI handling, a plus Our BenefitsIn addition to competitive salaries, this role includes:Formal employment (“Planilla”) under a Peruvian entity — all legal benefits in soles (CTS, Gratificaciones, etc.).Full-time schedule: Monday–Friday, 9am–6pm.Unlimited vacation days 🏖️ — yes, we mean it!EPS healthcare (Rimac) covered 100%.Oncology insurance (Rimac) covered 100%.AFP retirement plan.Coworking access in Miraflores, Lima — with free beverages, talks, bicycle parking, and amazing city views.Company laptop and tools provided.Disclaimer: This position is also open for candidates with some kind of disabilities that are part of the CONADIS list. The coworking is adequate for people with special mobility needs.Our CompanyWe have a relatively flat organizational structure here at OpenLoop. Everyone is encouraged to bring ideas to the table and make things happen. This fits in well with our core values of Autonomy, Competence and Belonging, as we want everyone to feel empowered and supported to do their best work.Sound like a good fit? We’d love to meet you. title: Applied AI & Automation Consultant

title: Agentic Commerce AI Agent Algorithm Engineer
description: About The TeamAbout Us Sea Group is establishing a brand-new, strategic AI department. This department is dedicated to exploring the transformative potential of generative AI in revolutionizing human connection, self-expression and communication diversity, and social interaction. We are building the next generation of AI-native applications and a comprehensive Model-as-a-Service (MaaS) product support system. Based on massive multi-country data, we are building a leading multilingual AI ecosystem from the ground up. We look forward to more outstanding talents joining us to build leading Southeast Asian multilingual models and explore innovative AI-native applications.The AI application team focuses on the intersection of social connectivity and artificial intelligence. Our mission is to leverage LLMs to create digital personas that can act as personal assistants and social bridges. This team operates with a startup's agility backed by our Group's robust resources, aiming to define how humans interact in the AI era.Job DescriptionDesign and optimize a consumer-facing e-commerce Shopping Agent, covering intent understanding, task planning, query rewriting, product search/recommendation, tool calling, memory, and multi-turn dialogue.Develop and implement post-training pipelines such as SFT, DPO, PPO/RLHF, and Reward Modeling, covering data construction, training, evaluation, deployment, and regression.Improve tool-use accuracy, instruction following, product relevance, factual consistency, personalization, and hallucination control through data and model alignment.Build post-training datasets and evaluation systems combining human evaluation, automated metrics, and LLM-as-a-Judge.Drive continuous optimization based on offline evaluation, A/B testing, user experience, conversion, latency, cost, and stability.Collaborate with product, engineering, search/recommendation, and operations teams to deploy Agent capabilities in large-scale e-commerce scenarios.RequirementsMaster’s degree or above in Computer Science, AI, or a related fieldAt least three years of experience in machine learning, NLP, search/recommendation, or LLM applications.Hands-on experience with at least one post-training method, such as SFT, DPO, PPO/RLHF, or Reward Modeling.Familiarity with training frameworks such as Megatron-LM, veRL, or DeepSpeed, and basic knowledge of distributed training.Experience with Agent, Function Calling, Tool-use, multi-turn dialogue, and LLM evaluation.Strong Python, engineering, data-analysis, and production problem-solving skills.Experience with e-commerce AI, large-scale post-training, Agent RL, self-play, or synthetic data is a strong plus.
